title: What is 7thCare?
content: 7thCare is a health technology platform that connects users to healthcare services, consultations, and vendors, while protecting your privacy.

title: Is 7thCare available in my location?
content: We currently operate in Niegria and Canada. You can check availability by entering your location on our website.

title: Can I use 7thCare without creating an account?
content: Yes, for some services like browsing available vendors or basic health tips. However, booking or ordering requires a secure account.

title: How do I contact customer support?
content: You can reach us via the in-app chat, our “Contact Us” form, or email at info@7thcare.com.

title: Is my personal information safe?
content: Absolutely. We use advanced encryption and comply with data protection laws to ensure your privacy.

title: What devices can I use to access 7thCare?
content: 7thCare works on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers.

title: Does 7thCare store my medical history?
content: Only if you choose to. Your health data is encrypted and never shared without your consent.

title: Can I refer friends or family?
content: Yes! Use your referral code to invite others and enjoy rewards when they sign up.

title: Is 7thCare free to use?
content: Some features are free, but certain services like consultations or medication deliveries may have fees.

title: How can I give feedback on the platform?
content: Use the “Feedback” option in your account menu or email info@7thcare.com.

title: How do I create a 7thCare account?
content: Click “Sign Up” on our homepage, fill in your details, and verify via email or SMS.

title: Do I need to provide personal details to sign up?
content: Minimal details are required, and for anonymous services, no identifying information is needed.

title: How do I update my account details?
content: Log in, go to “Account Settings,” and edit your profile information.

title: Can I delete my account?
content: Yes. You can request deletion in “Account Settings” or by contacting support.

title: How do I find a healthcare provider?
content: Use the search bar or filters to find consultants, hospitals, or vendors that fit your needs.

title: What happens after I book a consultation?
content: You’ll receive a confirmation and instructions on how to join your session.

title: Can I use 7thCare anonymously?
content: Yes, you can book consultations and order medications without sharing personal information.

title: How do I track my order or booking?
content: Check the “My Orders” or “My Bookings” section in your dashboard.

title: Do I need a prescription to order medications?
content: For certain drugs, yes. You can upload your prescription or book a consultation to get one.

title: What payment methods do you accept?
content: We accept credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and mobile money options.

title: Is there a service fee?
content: A small service fee may apply depending on the service type. This will be shown before checkout.

title: Can I get a receipt for my payment?
content: Yes, receipts are automatically emailed after payment.

title: How do refunds work?
content: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to your original payment method.

title: Can I pay in installments?
content: Currently, we require full payment upfront, but installment options may be added in the future.

title: Is my payment information secure?
content: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption and never store your card details.

title: Do prices include taxes?
content: Taxes are included unless stated otherwise at checkout.

title: How do I update my payment method?
content: Go to “Billing” in your account settings and add or remove payment options.

title: What should I do if my payment fails?
content: Double-check your details, try again, or contact your bank. If the issue persists, reach out to our support team.

title: Can I get a breakdown of charges?
content: Yes. An itemized invoice will be available in your “Billing” section after payment.

title: How do I change my password?
content: Go to “Account Settings” > “Security” and select “Change Password.”

title: I forgot my password. What should I do?
content: Click “Forgot Password” on the login page and follow the instructions to reset it.

title: The app/website is not loading. How can I fix it?
content: Try refreshing, clearing your cache, or switching networks.

title: I’m not receiving verification emails.
content: Check your spam folder or verify that you entered the correct email address.

title: My video consultation is not connecting.
content: Ensure you have a stable internet connection and allow camera/microphone access.

title: I can’t upload my prescription.
content: Check the file size and format. Supported formats include JPG, PNG, and PDF.

title: The app is crashing.
content: Update to the latest version or reinstall the app.

title: I’m having trouble making a payment.
content: Ensure your payment method is valid and supported. If the issue persists, contact support.

title: Notifications aren’t showing up.
content: Enable notifications in your device settings and in the app preferences.

title: Why is my order status not updating?
content: It may take a few minutes to reflect changes. If it stays the same for over 24 hours, contact support.

title: How do I report a bug?
content: Use the “Report a Problem” option in your account menu or email techsupport@7thcare.com.
